title: Crazy Coin Poker
description:
Poker × Coin Pusher × RoguelikeWhen buffs start chaining together,
your gameplay transforms in an instant.

A new kind of Poker × Coin Pusher experience driven by “momentum”!

Features• Buffs twist the poker rules (extra hole cards, more community cards, skewed probabilities, multiplier boosts)

• Flashy hit effects for instant dopamine

• Every play generates a completely different flow and outcome

Experience a payout that puts arcade jackpots to shame — with no ceiling.

Poker Like You’ve Never Seen Before• Buffs can push you into 3-card hands / 6-card boards

• Reward multipliers can skyrocket instantly

• “Bias Buffs” make certain hands dramatically easier to hit

Fusion with Coin Pusher Mechanics• Every medal (coin) passing the sensor gives you Poker chips

• Accumulate chips to raise your payout multiplier: 1.5x → 2.0x → 2.5x → ...

• Stronger poker hands output more medals

Example:
Straight: 32 medals × Multiplier 10× = 320 medals!?

Random Buffs That Completely Reshape Poker• 50+ unique buffs

• Increased hand probability (Straights, Flushes, etc.)

• More hole cards / more community cards — rules themselves shift

• Meta buffs such as increased buff acquisition rate

• Multiple buffs combining can trigger explosive, unpredictable outcomes

Easy to pick up, endlessly exciting• Short sessions with big swings

• Every run produces unexpected combinations

• Lights, SFX, animations, and effects that feel great

• Poker × Coin Pusher synergy creates a uniquely satisfying loop

— One buff can change everything —
description_short: A high-octane fusion of Poker × Coin Pusher! Launch coins, build powerful hands, and score massive payouts. A roguelike buff system sends multipliers sky-high. Stronger hands trigger crazier effects—blinding lights, explosions, and pure dopamine-fueled chaos.
